annotations.title: One approval link for every waiting post

description: One link for someone without an account to see every post waiting for approval in the workspace (up to 25, oldest first) and approve them all with one tap, or send any back with a comment. post_ids narrows it to some of them. Works for 7 days, until each post is decided here or there, or when revoked (approval_link_revoke). The recipient defaults to the workspace's client. Send the url to them yourself; it's shown only once. The activity log shows each decision as Approval link (recipient).

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

post_ids.description: Only these waiting posts; leave out for all of them

recipient.description: Who it's for: their email, or a note like 'Dana at Acme'. Leave out to use the workspace's client

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
